prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Extreme wide shot. Black rain clouds hang low over a dry valley where a giant long rectangular wooden crate of rough planks smeared pitch-black, with a flat plank roof and flat square ends, as tall at both ends as in the middle stands alone on a hill, its roof empty and flat, a fork of lightning glowing deep inside the clouds. Dusk, the dry grass bent flat by a cold wind, dust hanging over the slopes. Ominous and vast. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No people, no text, no logos.
